passage: Kou Peis contested the succession but lost the election to Veillpea Dourn in 45 and was cast out.
corrected: Veillpea Dourn contested the claim of the named heir Kou Peis in 45, took the seat, and Kou Peis was cast out.
note: the contester and the heir are reversed; the same swap as row 8, in a second section
